method: Rain: NOAA HRRR forecast (latest 00/06/12/18z cycle, 48 h). Gate: flood model only when a town forecast 6 h / 24 h maximum reaches the thresholds. Flood rain: each hour of HRRR rain replaced by the 90th percentile within 20 km (allows for displaced storm cores). Flood: LISFLOOD-FP 8.2, 20 m, 20 x 20 km boxes on the heaviest rain, NRCS curve-number losses (calibrated on the Sept 2023 Leominster storm). Closure: P = Phi((peak depth - 0.30 m) / 0.10 m) along the segment (proto/prototype.py). Hindcast skill: docs/proto/forecast/HINDCAST.md. Ensemble: the flood model is run on 8 time-lagged HRRR cycles (this one, the 3 previous 6-hourly cycles and the 4 hourly cycles before it); likely closed = closed in >= 2 of 8 (validated out of sample on 7 storms, docs/proto/forecast/ENSEMBLE.md).

k_of_n.rule: likely closed = closed (P >= 0.5) in >= 2 of the 8 time-lagged HRRR members; possible = 1 of 8 (ENSEMBLE.md, validated on 9 storms)

ensemble.rule: likely closed: >= 2 of the 8 members; possible: 1 of 8

coverage: Flood model: 4 boxes of 20 × 20 km on the heaviest forecast rain
kind: The flood model ran in these boxes only (GitHub Actions); roads outside them were not modelled. The rain gate covers all of District 3.

shadow.label: Shadow run, not the forecast: whole District 3 at 20 m (Turing GPU)
shadow.note: Not the forecast: the whole-district run over-flags about 3x against the radar run (docs/proto/forecast/DISTRICT.md).
